method.generated: Classify the exact complement of 39 source declarations. Record each auxiliary theorem separately without treating generated constants as extra handwritten proofs.
method.ownership: Actual defining module is not inferred from the name prefix or from the owner of a related source definition.
method.receipt_binding: Bind the classification to fixed commit/tree, accepted command, formal six-target strict/replay stages, inventory log and complete archived evidence.
method.actions: Read source/Git objects/receipt data and write only this classification and a new mathematical-acceptance binding. No Lean, cloud, tests, verifier/source/docs mutation, or publication.
